subject: CloudLedger onboarding: integration blocker — request for short runway and credits
messages:
From: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@cloudledger.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Cc: eng@cloudledger.com
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding timeline — running into an integration blocker

Hi Marissa,

We're excited to get Redwood integrated — the PoC looked great. Unfortunately, while wiring our webhook/transform pipeline into the staging environment we hit a cascade of schema mismatches inside our adapter layer that is blocking ingestion. Our engineering team attached a short log snippet and the failing payloads (integration-error-log.txt).

Because of this, we will not be able to complete end-to-end validation by the originally planned demo on Friday. We'd like to ask whether you can provide a short extension (1 week) on the evaluation sandbox and if possible a small top‑up of sandbox credits so we can run additional test cycles while we fix the adapter.

Practical asks:
- Sandbox extension through Friday 21 May
- +$1,000 equivalent in dev credits to cover extra token usage during debugging
- Keep our dedicated demo slot and your assistance with a quick tokenization/compatibility check with your SDK team

Appreciate any help — we want to keep momentum for the end‑of‑month decision.

Thanks,
Aisha Khan
Head of Integrations, CloudLedger

From: marissa cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@cloudledger.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, dev.patel@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding timeline — running into an integration blocker

Hi Aisha — thanks for the clear note and the logs. Sorry to hear about the schema pain; we see that pattern often with third‑party adapters.

Short answer: yes, we can do a 7‑day extension and provision a small emergency credit package while your engineers triage. Ben — can you confirm whether $1,000 in sandbox credits is available from the PoC allowance? Dev — please attempt the quick SDK tokenization sanity check Aisha mentioned and flag any obvious mismatch.

I'll follow up with a formal make‑good note and scope our support time. If CloudLedger is comfortable, we can schedule a 30 minute troubleshooting session tomorrow with one of our SDK engineers. Would 10am PT work?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachment: mutual-action-plan.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: ben carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, aisha.khan@cloudledger.com
Cc: dev.patel@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding timeline — running into an integration blocker

Marissa / Aisha — I confirmed with the PoC ledger: we have $1,200 of discretionary sandbox credits we can allocate to CloudLedger for this debugging window. I'll provision $1,000 now and leave $200 as buffer.

Dev — I'll add you to the provisioning ticket. Marissa — I'll send a short approval note to finance so we can log this as a customer success makegood instead of a promo.

Aisha — 10am PT tomorrow works for our SDK engineer, Dev Patel. He'll bring a small checklist to rule out tokenization + KV caching issues. In the meantime, can you share the failing payloads in a zipped file? The snippet you sent points to escaped characters + inconsistent content-length in the header — that's the usual culprit.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Director, Commercials | Redwood Inference

From: dev patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@cloudledger.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 16:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding timeline — running into an integration blocker

Hi Aisha — great to meet you earlier today. Quick summary of what we verified during the call and next steps: 

What we checked (10am PT session):
- Confirmed payload encoding: CloudLedger was sending UTF‑8 but with a legacy BOM for some payloads; Redwood SDK currently assumes BOMless UTF‑8.
- Verified tokenizer boundary behavior for long metadata fields; we saw token boundary truncation in a nested field when the content-length header was misreported.
- Confirmed that prefix caching caused repeated 413s on replays when body length changed.

Immediate remediation plan:
1) CloudLedger: strip BOM on inbound staging webhook (quick patch) — ETA 1 day.
2) Redwood: add a defensive BOM‑tolerant parser to SDK v1.12.1 (we'll ship a hotfix to your staging image by EOD Monday).
3) Demo: reschedule to Friday 21 May at the same time — Marissa will confirm the slot and Ben has provisioned $1,000 in sandbox credits.

I'll follow up with the Jira ticket (ENG-1123) with logs and a short PR link. If everything validates in staging we should be green for the final demo window.

Regards,
Dev Patel
SDK Engineer | Redwood Inference
